action_inputs.description: Branch or tag to sync from. CloudBolt reads it from a URL path segment, so it must not contain a slash.
action_inputs.label: Branch or tag (no slash)
action_inputs.name: sync_branch

action_inputs.description: Ignore the enabled flag in the metadata and keep each action's current enabled state (default false).
action_inputs.label: Ignore enabled flag (default false)
action_inputs.name: sync_ignore_action_enabled

action_inputs.description: Repo-relative content paths, one per line or comma-separated: <top-level dir>/<GLOBAL_ID> or the path of a file inside that folder. Forms and form functions cannot be listed; sync the blueprint or action that references them.
action_inputs.label: Content paths, one per line
action_inputs.name: sync_paths

action_inputs.description: Refresh objects that already exist with the same global id (default true). When false an existing object is reported as a failure.
action_inputs.label: Refresh existing objects (default true)
action_inputs.name: sync_refresh_if_exists

action_inputs.description: Source Control Repository global id (SCR-...) or label. Omit when the appliance has exactly one repository.
action_inputs.label: Repository (SCR id or label)
action_inputs.name: sync_repo

description: Creates a Source Control Repository sync job for the given branch and content paths so an agent can import or refresh content it pushed, and returns the job id to poll.
name: Sync From Source Control Repo
